content:
For my {C}name is Jock {G}Stewart,
I'm a {C}canny gaun {F}man,
And a {C}roving young {G}fellow
I've {C}been.{G}

So be {C}easy and {G}free,
when you're {C}drinkin' with {F}me,
I'm a {C}man you don't {G}meet every {C}day.

I have acres of land,
I have men to command,
I have always a shilling
to spare.

Now, I took out my gun
with my dog for to shoot
all down by the river
Kildare.

So, come fill up your glasses
with brandy and wine,
and whatever the cost,
I will pay.
title: Jock Stewart
